Smith and Karpinski’s history of the Indian numerals and of the zero, their earliest forms in the Brāhmī inscriptions and their journey through the Arabs to Europe (Boston, 1911). Listed in the catalogue of the Rare Book Society of India.

From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Scanned from a copy in the University of California Libraries; hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: The Hindu-Arabic numerals · Smith, David Eugene, 1860-1944, Karpinski, Louis Charles, 1878-1956, joint author · 1911, 190 scanned pages. Published 1911; David Eugene Smith died 1944 and Louis Charles Karpinski 1956; public domain in India.

This book is not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit. The text of each page is the machine-read (OCR) text of the scan, lightly cleaned; the scan of every page is one button away. The item on the Internet Archive (opened only if you click it).
